title: Prepositions

explanation.en: Common patterns include at 9 AM, on Monday, in November, send to someone, and prepare for a meeting.
explanation.taglish: Tandaan ang patterns: at 9 AM, on Monday, in November, send to, at prepare for. Halimbawa: I'll send the report to Maria on Friday.
explanation.fil: Gamitin ang at para sa tiyak na oras, on para sa araw, at in para sa buwan o taon.

examples: I'll send the report to Maria on Friday.

exercises.explanation: Use at for clock times, on for days, and in for months or years. Correct answer: on
exercises.hint: Look at the noun after the preposition.

exercises.explanation: Use to for the person receiving something. Correct answer: at
exercises.hint: For time, decide whether it is a clock time, day, or month.

exercises.prompt: Correct: 'I sent the email for Maria.' (Maria is the recipient.)
options: I sent the email to Maria.
I sent the email on Maria.
I sent the email at Maria.
exercises.explanation: Use for when referring to preparation or purpose. Correct answer: I sent the email to Maria.
exercises.hint: Learn common word combinations as a phrase.

options: We are preparing for the meeting.
We are preparing on the meeting.
We are preparing at the meeting.
exercises.explanation: Use for when referring to preparation or purpose. Correct answer: We are preparing for the meeting.
exercises.hint: Learn common word combinations as a phrase.

exercises.prompt: Does this sentence need correction? 'I'll send it to you on Friday.'
exercises.explanation: Use for when referring to preparation or purpose. Correct answer: No change needed.
exercises.hint: Learn common word combinations as a phrase.

writing.prompt: Write one sentence using a time preposition and one using 'to' or 'for'.
writing.exampleAnswer: We meet on Friday at nine.

sections.heading: Time
sections.explanation: Use at for clock times, on for days, and in for months or years.
sections.example: at 9 AM; on Monday; in November

sections.heading: Direction and recipients
sections.explanation: Use to for the person receiving something.
sections.example: I sent the report to Ana.

sections.heading: Purpose
sections.explanation: Use for when referring to preparation or purpose.

guidedSteps: Look at the noun after the preposition.
For time, decide whether it is a clock time, day, or month.
Learn common word combinations as a phrase.
commonMistake: 'We meet in Monday' should be 'We meet on Monday'.
